Nothing qualifies. The queue is unchanged (it is empty, and stays empty).

**What I read:** all 17 open tickets (`npx tickets list`) with their plans' `Effort:`/`Uncertainty:`, and the queue.

**Why nothing was queued:** the bar is a low effort *and no uncertainty*. No open plan records uncertainty 0 — the whole board runs 2 to 8. The closest is `2026-09-22_topics-for-untopiced-tickets` (effort 1, uncertainty 2): giving 8 tickets a `Topics:` line, only ticket files touched. I read its plan in full — the 2 is honest, it names three ways (fill the 8 by hand; also change two skills so new tickets get topics; take topics from issue labels) and recommends the first. Meaningful alternatives exist, so it is not "no uncertainty", and I left it alone rather than bend the rule.

No ticket was skipped for being claimed, queued, or in review — none is. The rest are plainly not quick wins (effort 3–8, uncertainty 4–8), and no plan records a decision not to do the work.

This is the 27th run of this skill and the 27th time it queued nothing; the bar as written has never once been met on this board. I noted the run in memory alongside the item-5 plan that already proposes fixing the rule (quick = effort ≤ 2 and uncertainty ≤ 2, which would queue exactly the topics ticket).
